examples.title: Debt collection
examples.summary: Verify, disclose, negotiate, take payment — charge gated on a confirmed promise to pay; extraction fills the amount and date from speech.

examples.title: Patient intake
examples.summary: Identify, triage, schedule — scheduling hard-blocked on an emergency verdict; escalation stays ambient in every step.

examples.title: Line support
examples.summary: Authenticate, run a line diagnostic, reset or raise a single-use engineer ticket — no ticket without a diagnostic.

examples.title: Call screening
examples.summary: Identify the caller and intent, filter spam, transfer or take a message — transfer gated on the spam verdict from extraction.

examples.title: Returns desk
examples.summary: Locate the order, check eligibility, refund once or offer credit — the refund is a single-use commit behind eligibility.

examples.title: Table booking
examples.summary: Booking with durable memory: remembered diet and seating fill governed slots, a computed large-party flag steers the model, and booking stays gated on a real availability check.
